credits.title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
credits.overview: When a forbidden Indonesian exorcism is broadcast live online, it unleashes a legendary demonic entity across Asia, forcing the grieving son of a Taiwanese victim to trace the curse back to its ancient, blood-soaked roots in rural Indonesia before it consumes everyone in its digital wake.

credits.title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
credits.overview: Raised in the shadow of an emotionally distant father, a young woman must step up during a family crisis and navigate the burdens of adulthood without the guidance she always craved.

credits.title: Dignitate
credits.overview: Alfi meets Alana, a new student at school. It turns out that they are in one class and sitting next to each other. Instead of getting along, they often argue because they both are stubborn.
